item.title: Our Savior’s Lutheran School students find out more about FFA
item.description: Isabel Pahlen, Crookston FFA member, visited Our Savior’s Lutheran School on Thursday. She shared information about what FFA is as well as presenting lessons and activities on plants, farm animals, Minnesota wildlife, and farm machinery.
